einzeiler: JJ Martin on transcendental travel, raising your vibration, and spiritual spaces.
kurzfassung: JJ Martin discusses her move to Milan, building her fashion brand The Double J, and her journey into spirituality. She explains how travel can induce shifts in consciousness through sacred sites, ancient traditions, and energy centers. The conversation explores destinations like Bali, Florence, Egypt, Sardinia, and Cappadocia, blending style with a pursuit of deeper awareness.
stichpunkte: Reflecting on twenty-five years in Milan and developing a hard-working mentality in fashion media.
Connecting maximalist fashion to the mission of raising personal vibration and radiance.
Overcoming initial cultural friction in Italy through patience, kindness, and genuine enthusiasm.
Using travel as a tool for transcendental experiences and expanding consciousness rather than just shopping.
Exploring ancient energy vortexes and power points such as sacred wells, giants' tombs, and temples.
Visiting spiritual destinations like Bali, Egypt, Sardinia, Ireland, and Cappadocia with a focus on local traditions.
Integrating spiritual awareness and embodiment into a dense physical world and daily life.

kapitel.titel: Sacred Sites from Egypt to Sardinia

clips.hook: Why some people have an aversion to wearing color
clips.text: An aversion to bright clothing typically stems from a deeper discomfort with being noticed and standing out in the world.
A local artisan shop in Florence creates custom leather collars and leashes for pets using exceptionally chic materials.

clips.hook: When local shopkeepers close for lunch
clips.text: Early grocery store owners in Italy strictly prioritize their lunch break over making a sale, refusing customers during designated rest times.
The primary attraction of travel should be connecting with locations that broaden one's perception and consciousness rather than just focusing on shopping.
Mount Etna offers the extraordinary experience of hiking to the summit while it actively erupts and shoots lava nearby.

beschreibung:
JJ Martin has spent 25 years in Milan building the maximalist fashion label La DoubleJ — and along the way, a full philosophy of living. She joins David to talk about the sacred sites and energetic power points that fuel her: Volcanoes in Sicily, water temples in Bali, caves in Cappadocia, and stone circles in Ireland.
